title: What It Actually Costs a Godly Man to Go First
caption:
Leadership by title picks the good slot. Leadership by cost takes the shift nobody wants, the apology at 60% fault, the truth that might cost the relationship.

A godly man doesn't wait for full agreement on blame before he owns his share. He doesn't wait for someone braver to name what the room already knows. He goes first into the part that costs him something, because that's the whole definition Christ gave the word.

Whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant (Mark 10:43). Not whoever wants a title.

Go first this week. Somebody has to.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
